summary: Consolidated Jan-2026 regression (Parabola Heritage, TRACE, Annie Rose, La Marva, Rhythm Mesh, Shop audit, merchant feed). 29/30 pytest assertions pass. Backend resolver + PDPs are fully aligned with the owner-approved USD matrix. Found 1 CRITICAL bug (PARABOLA HERITAGE cannot complete checkout — slug mismatch) and 3 feed-vs-resolver mismatches that look pre-existing. All other owner expectations met: PH tier cards + badges + default US10, no Rose Gold, no fourth tier; TRACE 4 tiers; live-metal rings PDP == server to the dollar; /shop shows 0 CAD, correct From-prices; merchant-feed.xml 200 OK, application/xml, 23 USD items, no CAD.

minor.issue: Returns $150 USD (CAD 225 → 0.75 → rounded to $50 step) but merchant-feed.xml says 225 USD and OVATION PDP displays $225. Server-authoritative price ($150) therefore disagrees with every public surface for silver tier.

Returns unrounded $11,334 USD (both tiers). Merchant feed advertises 8500 USD. /shop card renders 'From $11,334' (non-luxury-stepped). Add convert_usd_luxury=True in PRICING_ENGINE_CATALOG['coogi-dna-tag'] OR fix the pricing_engine tier amounts.
Server lowest tier returns $5,000 USD but merchant feed says 14500 USD and shop card presumably shows a 'From' price derived from a higher tier. Feed should quote the lowest purchasable tier price.

ui_bugs.issue: PARABOLA HERITAGE is marked 'Not available for online checkout yet — please remove to continue' on /checkout and the Pay button is disabled, even though services/catalog.resolve_line_item fully supports it. Root cause: RingProductPage.jsx line 167 writes `slug: product.id` → cart item's `slug` is `parabolaHeritage` (camelCase) instead of `parabola-heritage` (dash-case). Checkout.jsx `SUPPORTED_SLUGS` is keyed in dash-case, so isSupportedItem(cart_item) returns false. Repro: add Yellow Gold US 10 to cart → /checkout → see orange warning + disabled Pay. Fix: change RingProductPage.jsx:167 to `slug: product.slug || product.id` (all other dynamic ring pages set id === slug so no regression; ParabolaHeritagePage is the only ring where they diverge).
Card displays 'From $11,334' — a non-stepped USD value — breaking the luxury-rounded presentation used by every other dynamic card.

integration_issues.issue: Cart→Checkout integration fails for PH only. Backend accepts the resolve, but frontend blocks the Pay click. Zero customer can purchase PARABOLA HERITAGE online right now.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/RingProductPage.jsx line 167 — change `slug: product.id` to `slug: product.slug || product.id`. Verify PARABOLA HERITAGE Yellow Gold US 10 can be added, retains $7,800 USD across /cart reload, and the /checkout Pay button becomes enabled.

LOW: Add convert_usd_luxury=True (or hand-set USD) to coogi-dna-tag in PRICING_ENGINE_CATALOG so the card no longer shows 'From $11,334'. Decide whether $11,334 (server) or $8,500 (merchant feed) is the owner-approved price and sync both surfaces.

LOW: OVATION silver tier: server returns $150, PDP + feed show $225. Pick one and align (likely mark OVATION as usd_hand_set=True like PARABOLA/PARABOLA-HERITAGE so lockedBasePriceCad is interpreted as USD).
LOW: lady-jay merchant feed price (14500 USD) does not match lowest-purchasable tier (foundation=$5,000). Regenerate feed from the resolver's lowest-tier price.
critical_code_review_comments: RingProductPage.jsx:167 — using `product.id` as the cart `slug` is unsafe when `product.id` is not kebab-case. ParabolaHeritagePage.jsx uses `id: 'parabolaHeritage'` (camelCase, matches products.<key>) while all other dynamic ring pages use kebab-case ids that happen to equal the slug. Prefer `product.slug || product.id`.

Checkout.jsx:68 — isSupportedItem relies on a frontend-maintained copy of _SUPPORTED_SLUGS. This duplication keeps drifting. Expose a GET /api/catalog/supported-slugs endpoint and fetch it once per session, or key by `productKey` (which the cart already stores) instead of slug.

services/pricing_engine_catalog.py — some products (coogi-dna-tag, likely others) resolve to non-rounded USD amounts. The frontend's luxury-step rounding is implicit; the backend should mirror it to keep server-authoritative prices stepped and avoid 'From $11,334'-style card prices.

scripts/generate_merchant_feed.py / public/merchant-feed.xml appears stale relative to the current resolver (ovation 225 vs 150, lady-jay 14500 vs 5000). The merchant feed should be regenerated whenever the resolver changes.

success_rate.backend: 97% (29/30 pytest asserts pass; 1 failure is a legitimate merchant-feed vs resolver mismatch on 3 pre-existing products)
success_rate.frontend: 70% — All PDP tier/badge/price checks pass; PARABOLA HERITAGE checkout is BROKEN due to slug mismatch.

rca of the issue: PARABOLA HERITAGE checkout block — RCA: RingProductPage.jsx constructs the cart line with `slug: product.id`. ParabolaHeritagePage sets `id: 'parabolaHeritage'` (camelCase) and `slug: 'parabola-heritage'` (dash-case). The cart line therefore stores `slug: 'parabolaHeritage'`. Checkout.jsx's SUPPORTED_SLUGS set contains `'parabola-heritage'` (dash-case) → isSupportedItem returns false → warning banner + disabled Pay. Reproduction: /products/parabola-heritage → select tier-yellowGold10k → Add to Cart → /checkout. Fix: `slug: product.slug || product.id` on RingProductPage.jsx line 167 (and EarringsProductPage.jsx line 66, defensively).
